header: Stages joined by arrows, from input to output
lead: Use it when the boxes are system states, not tasks for the reader; for steps the reader performs, use How It Works. The chain below is how this catalogue renders an element.
note: Each stage can change on its own: a new theme leaves the templates alone, and a new template leaves the fields alone.

stages.title: Field definition
stages.text: A Content Block’s config.yaml declares the fields an editor fills in.

stages.title: Fluid template
stages.text: The element composes Astryx components and adds only its own layout.

stages.title: Theme tokens
stages.text: The active theme supplies colour, type and corner radius.

stages.title: Rendered page
stages.text: Plain HTML from the server, with one small script for tabs and carousels.
